title: Code of practice for chromate conversion coating on zinc and cadmium coated articles and zinc base alloys
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This code lays down the procedure for providing protective coating, on zinc and cadmium coated articles and zinc base alloys intended primarily to prevent or reduce their corrosion under humid conditions.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Method of tests for chromate coatings on zinc and cadimium surfaces
Specification for Trichloroethylene, Technical ( Fourth Revision )

clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for chromate conversion coating on zinc and cadmium coated articles and zinc base alloys

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
